unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 "Add a Nano (XNO) settlement scheme beside the MultiversX facilitator — zero inherent gas, block-as-receipt" on sasurobert/blockrun-multiversx-gateway. Argued in its own terms: it sponsors zero gas via Relayed V3 relayer nodes; Nano is the rail where zero gas is inherent (feeless), preserving its micro-cent precision in raw units (1e30), and the confirmed block is the immutable receipt its /verify + /settle facilitator already wants. Carried live Vend nano-info endpoint. https://github.com/sasurobert/blockrun-multiversx-gateway/issues/1
